note: Learned from 212-case evaluation. pos_win_rate = fraction of positive cases won by the style (its home-turf reliability). neg_loss_rate = fraction of negative cases where the style's failure mode fired (avoid-combined-without-gates). route when signature matches triggers AND pos_win_rate is high; add protective gates when neg_loss_rate is high.
